# hubspot_file (Resource)

Manages one HubSpot Managed file by generated `id`, with local bytes bound to a reviewed SHA-256 digest.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hubspot_file" "logo" {
  name          = "northstar-logo.svg"
  folder_id     = hubspot_file_folder.brand.id
  source_path   = "${path.module}/northstar-logo.svg"
  source_sha256 = "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef"
  access        = "PUBLIC_NOT_INDEXABLE"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `folder_id` (String) Generated destination File folder `id`; paths and implicit folders are not accepted.
- `name` (String) Managed file name in the explicit destination folder. It is mutable presentation, not identity.
- `source_path` (String, Sensitive) Sensitive local regular-file path read at plan and apply. Bytes never enter state or diagnostics.
- `source_sha256` (String) Exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters binding the planned source bytes.

### Optional

- `access` (String) Supported HubSpot delivery access state. Defaults to `PRIVATE`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) HubSpot RFC 3339 creation observation preserved through `PATCH` and `PUT`.
- `default_hosting_url` (String) Current HubSpot-hosted delivery URL; an observation, never identity.
- `encoding` (String) Nullable HubSpot content encoding observation.
- `extension` (String) HubSpot canonical file extension observation.
- `file_md5` (String) Lowercase HubSpot MD5 content observation used with size for drift repair.
- `height` (Number) Nullable HubSpot media height observation.
- `id` (String) HubSpot-generated file `id` used as the only state and import identity.
- `path` (String) HubSpot-derived current file path; an observation, never identity.
- `size` (Number) Current file size in decimal bytes.
- `type` (String) HubSpot canonical file type classification.
- `updated_at` (String) Current HubSpot RFC 3339 update observation.
- `url` (String) Current account-domain delivery URL; an observation, never identity.
- `width` (Number) Nullable HubSpot media width observation.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
tofu import hubspot_file.logo 987654321
```
